answer: Compare every new answer against the whole epoch's pool using embedding similarity, then cluster the near-duplicates. A sybil farm running one model with one prompt keeps blooming the same lotus of phrasing, even when it reshuffles words or swaps a sonnet-like flourish for plain timber prose. Clusters that recur across epochs get their rewards held and their members' grades reweighted, so cheap copies earn less than one honest voice.
